page_title: JUV 2-2 BOL | Juventus v Bologna 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90+2' 2 - 2 Goal! Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) neatly controls a decent pass from Dusan Vlahovic. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the top right corner from the edge of the box. 2:2.
90+1' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Juventus take a short corner kick.

89' Juventus are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Juventus.
88' Ball possession – 53:47.
87' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) picks up an injury.
84' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Benjamin Dominguez will be replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Bologna).
84' Here's the change. Emil Holm leaves the pitch and Stefan Posch (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.
83' The main referee, Matteo Marchetti, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is given a yellow card for dissent.
83' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a yellow card from the referee for dissent.
82' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
80' Tommaso Pobega goes off the pitch and Nikola Moro (Bologna) comes on.
80' Substitution. Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) replaces Santiago Castro.
80' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Federico Gatti is replaced by Nicolo Savona (Juventus).
80' The referee signals a substitution. Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Timothy Weah.

79' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
78' Emil Holm (Bologna) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
77' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
76' The foul by Santiago Castro (Bologna) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Matteo Marchetti.
76' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Bologna will take a throw-in.
74' The current number of corner kicks is 0:4.
72' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Matteo Marchetti ignores the protests.
71' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Mattia Perin makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
68' Jonas Rouhi (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Skorupski intercepts the ball.
67' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:3.
64' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) replaces Manuel Locatelli.
64' The game has come to an end for Nicolo Fagioli. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
62' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Danilo tees up Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Lukasz Skorupski.
61' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
61' Juan Miranda (Bologna) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Bologna manage to earn a corner.
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jens Odgaard will be replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
59' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.
58' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
57' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
56' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
52' 0 - 2 GOAL - 0:2! Santiago Castro found Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Mattia Perin off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
51' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Thiago Motta, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!

48' Bologna show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bologna.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Matteo Marchetti has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' Unbelievable! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) wastes a huge scoring opportunity! He finds himself unmarked right in front of goal and fires in a first-time shot. Lukasz Skorupski pulls off one of the best saves of his career and stops the effort from hitting the net.

45+2' Timothy Weah (Juventus) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' Santiago Castro (Bologna) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
42' The foul by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) was seen by Matteo Marchetti who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
40' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
38' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
35' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.

34' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
32' Matteo Marchetti shows a yellow card to Jens Odgaard (Bologna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
30' 0 - 1 Dan Ndoye (Bologna) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball under the crossbar.
27' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Matteo Marchetti decides there was no infringement by Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) and the game can continue.

26' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
24' Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul after Juan Miranda (Bologna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

23' Bologna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
20' Timothy Weah (Juventus) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
20' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
18' Timothy Weah (Juventus) sees a yellow card from Matteo Marchetti after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
16' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Juan Miranda (Bologna) but poses no threat. The linesman signals a throw-in for Juventus.
14' Thiago Motta is forced to make a change. Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jonas Rouhi.
12' Juventus are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

10' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) blows a good opportunity to score. Without any hesitation he fires in a shot from mid range, but the ball crashes against the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
7' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
6' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Good work from Bologna as they win a corner.
5' Juan Miranda (Bologna) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Juventus are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Juventus will kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
